about: What llama.cpp's server answered, recorded at the pinned build b11960 on 2026-10-29 (T93, docs/local-llm/server.md), as status and body. The first three are its own words; the fourth is its envelope as recorded, around a reply written by hand to break R6. godot/test/ai_llm/llm_test.gd hands each to HttpRuntime as request_completed would, with no server running, and holds the three apart: the request refused (F2), no reply yet (F1), and the model's reply refused by the validator (an R code).
